title: `_swap()` is vulnerable to sandwich attacks
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Anyone can buy a ticket from a specified pool, a certain payment token will be used to swap for meme tokens. The swapping process is implemented as below:  ```solidity     function _swap(         address token,         uint256 cost     ) private returns (uint256 actualTokens) {         Storage storage $ = _getOwnStorage();         IUniswapV2Router01 uni = IUniswapV2Router01($.uniswapRouter);         IUniswapV2Factory factory = IUniswapV2Factory($.uniswapFactory);          address pair = factory.getPair($.paymentToken, token);
